title: Sell Like a Pro
subtitle: Build a machine that turns cold strangers into paying customers.
description: Sales is the one skill that pays for every other mistake in business. You can have an average product with great sales and survive. You cannot have a great product with no sales and survive. This module gives you the complete sales toolkit from cold outreach to closing, from objection handling to pipeline management all powered by AI prompts that prepare you for every stage of the conversation.
